Strategic Objectives

The Union's inaugural General Assembly defined a set of strategic objectives that frame its work in service of Arab economic integration in the energy and minerals sectors:

01

Strengthen Arab integration by developing a cooperation network among governments, institutions and companies operating in the energy and minerals sectors.

02

Encourage Arab and international investment and valorize the region's inherent opportunities.

03

Contribute to strengthening Arab energy security and the sustainable management of natural resources.

04

Accompany the energy transition by supporting renewable-energy, green-hydrogen and energy-efficiency projects.

05

Promote the development of a mining sector aligned with international best practices.

06

Stimulate scientific research, innovation, technology transfer and the integration of new technologies.

07

Advance Arab economic diplomacy and the international standing of Arab countries in the energy and mining industries.

08

Reduce emissions and support clean energy in line with the Sustainable Development Goals.

Arab Union for Energy & Minerals

A pan-Arab institutional platform advancing joint Arab action in the energy and minerals sectors. Founded July 2026, headquartered in Casablanca.

Informational content based on official press coverage of the founding announcement.
